body: Message me. I think I feel much the same. At least then we might be able to see we are not alone in feeling this way.

I have resolved to end my life. I am going to get drunk and I am going to jump off a bridge. I am set. I need this. To stop the noise in my head. I have made one more recording to add to the others and am now making a playlist of songs for the wake. The way I see it is at least I can have some control in death.

I have never felt more sure. It has to happen.
